Tests for rendering a document's link references in markdown.
-- simple --
A document.

[foo]: u
-- want --
A document.

[foo]: u
-- sorted --
A document.

[foo]: u1
[bar]: u2
-- want --
A document.

[bar]: u2
[foo]: u1
-- interleaved --
First.

[foo]: u1
Second.

[bar]: u2
-- want --
First.

Second.

[bar]: u2
[foo]: u1
-- titles --
A document.

[r1]: u1 (title1)
[r2]: u2 "title2"
[r3]: u3 'title3'
-- full --
[Link][1]

[1]: u
-- collapsed --
[foo][]

[foo]: u
-- shortcut --
[foo]

[foo]: u
-- image --
![alt][1]

[1]: u
-- normalized label --
[Text][Foo  BAR]

[foo bar]: u
-- want --
[Text][foo bar]

[foo bar]: u
-- text no longer matching its label --
[&amp;]

[&amp;]: u
-- want --
[&][&amp;]

[&amp;]: u
-- text split across lines --
> [foo
> bar]
>
> [foo bar]: u
-- want --
> [foo
> bar][foo bar]

[foo bar]: u
-- unprintable label --
[a\]b] and [ok]

[a\]b]: u1
[ok]: u2
-- want --
[a\]b](u1) and [ok]

[ok]: u2
-- text attaching to a reference --
[foo]&lpar;bar&rpar; and [foo]&lbrack;x&rbrack;

[foo]: /url
-- want --
[foo]\(bar) and [foo]\[x]

[foo]: /url
-- text turning a reference into a definition --
[a]&colon; def shape

see [a]&colon; not a def

[a]: /u1
-- want --
[a]\: def shape

see [a]: not a def

[a]: /u1
